comment: It is the first tool I open in the morning. I check what the agent did overnight, approve two things and get on with my day.
We let go of our ad agency in week three. In October Autopilot launched 214 ad variations for us and blended ROAS went from 2.1 to 3.4.
Northpine lets our team of 6 run ads for 41 brands. We could not do that with people.
